description: This file defines functions and data structures for delta computing and patching, including index creation, delta generation, delta application, and memory management. It appears to be part of a delta encoding library.

methods.name: create_delta_index
methods.description: Compute index data from a given buffer, returning a pointer to an opaque delta_index structure.

methods.name: free_delta_index
methods.description: Free the memory allocated for a delta_index object.

methods.name: sizeof_delta_index
methods.description: Return the memory usage of a delta index.

methods.name: create_delta
methods.description: Generate a delta from the precomputed delta index for a given buffer, with optional maximum size constraint.

methods.name: patch_delta
methods.description: Recreate the target buffer from a source buffer and delta data.

methods.name: void * diff_delta(const void * src_buf,unsigned long src_bufsize,const void * trg_buf,unsigned long trg_bufsize,unsigned long * delta_size,unsigned long max_delta_size)
methods.description: Create a delta representing the difference between a source and target buffer.

methods.name: unsigned long get_delta_hdr_size(const unsigned char ** datap,const unsigned char * top)
methods.description: Retrieve the size of the delta header, to determine source and target buffer sizes.

ctags.signature: (const void * src_buf,unsigned long src_bufsize,const void * trg_buf,unsigned long trg_bufsize,unsigned long * delta_size,unsigned long max_delta_size)
